In this video, I explore Xingping Village, one of the most beautiful villages in China. Nestled along the Li River and surrounded by stunning karst mountains, this is the same landscape that appears on China’s 20 Yuan banknote.
Join me as I walk through ancient streets, experience local village life, discover breathtaking viewpoints, and see why millions of travelers consider Xingping one of the most scenic places in China.
